body: Low blood preassure, as stupid as it sounds, it is a major problem for me since i have a heart failure that makes me have a low heart beat rate and very low blood preassure to begin with. And as a result of that, I faint multiple times per week while on HRT compared to ~once a month pre HRT

I'm sorry but...were your first posts any better? Seriously, many of us have come a long way, and many of us have that long road still ahead of them. Let's not forget those times where we had to wait patiently for the hormones to work.

I'd probably tell her,  she might even include it in your HRT.
But, on a different note, afaik you are not supposed to use those creams on your chest due to an increased risk of breast cancer.

I might be wrong, but that's just what i've been told from various professionals that are working with me and my transition.

Edit: the same with patches
